items.sub: Tap every square this knight can jump to. If you don't know, tap "I don't know yet".
items.right: You know the knight!

items.question: is_check
items.say: Is the white king in check?
items.sub: Check means a piece is attacking the king.
items.right: Yes, the rook attacks the king.

items.say: Can you give checkmate in one move?
items.sub: You are white. Make the move.
items.right: Checkmate! You already know a lot.

items.sub: It looks like a castle tower. Tap the rook.
items.right: Yes! That's the rook.

items.say: The rook goes in straight lines.
items.sub: Up, down, left or right, as far as it likes. Tap every square it can reach.
items.right: You found them all! The rook goes straight, as far as it likes.

items.say: Now something is in the way.
items.sub: The rook can't jump. Tap every square it can reach now.
items.right: All of them! Your pawn blocks the rook, and so does your king.

items.say: The rook can take a piece on its line.
items.sub: Which black piece can the rook take?
items.right: Yes! The knight is on the rook's line, so the rook can take it.

hints.jumped: The queen is on the line, but the knight is in the way. The rook can't jump.

items.sub: Move the rook onto every star.
The rook can't go through them. Collect every star.
Tap every square this rook can go to.
items.right: Perfect. You know the rook.

items.sub: Tap every square it can go to.
items.right: You still know the rook!

items.sub: It has a pointed hat. Tap the bishop.
items.right: Yes! That's the bishop.

items.sub: Corner to corner, as far as it likes. Tap every square it can reach.
items.right: All of them! The bishop slides along the diagonals.

items.question: same_colour
items.say: This bishop is on a dark square.
items.sub: Can it ever reach the marked square, h7?
items.right: Right! A bishop stays on its own colour for the whole game. h7 is a light square.
items.why_wrong: Look at the colours. The bishop is on a dark square and h7 is light. A bishop always stays on its colour.

items.say: Your pawn is in the way.
items.sub: Tap every square the bishop can reach.
items.right: Yes! The pawn stops the bishop.

items.say: Which black piece can the bishop take?
items.sub: Follow the diagonals.
items.right: Yes! The knight is on the bishop's diagonal.

hints.jumped: The rook is on that diagonal, but the knight is in the way.
hints.not_on_line: The queen is straight up from the bishop. Bishops only go diagonally.

items.sub: Move the bishop onto every star.
Collect every star.
Tap every square this bishop can go to.
items.right: Perfect. You know the bishop.

items.sub: Tap every square it can go to.
items.right: You still know the bishop!

items.sub: She wears a crown of points. Tap the queen.
items.right: Yes! That's the queen, the strongest piece.

items.say: The queen moves like a rook and a bishop together.
items.sub: Straight lines and diagonals. Tap every square she can reach.
items.right: Wow, all of them! That's why the queen is so strong.

items.say: Which black piece can the queen take?
items.sub: Check every line. Some are blocked.
items.right: Yes! The bishop is on a clear diagonal.

hints.jumped: That line is blocked by your own pawn. The queen can't jump.

items.sub: Take all the black pawns before one reaches your side. Watch out: pawns take diagonally.
items.on_won: You took them all! Great queen moves.
items.on_lost: A pawn got through, or took your queen. Try again!

items.sub: The pawns are walls. Use straight lines and diagonals.
Which black piece can the queen take?
items.right: Perfect. You know the queen.

items.sub: Which black piece can she take?
items.right: You still know the queen!

items.sub: It looks like a horse. Tap the knight.
items.right: Yes! That's the knight.

items.say: The knight jumps in an L.
items.sub: Two squares one way, then one to the side. Tap every square it can land on.
items.right: All eight! The knight's L-jump.

items.sub: Where can it jump now?
items.right: Only two! A knight in the corner is weak.

items.say: The knight can jump over pieces.
items.sub: It's the only piece that can. Tap every square it can land on.
items.right: Yes! Nothing can block a knight.

items.say: Which black piece can the knight take?
items.sub: Think of the L-jump.
items.right: Yes! The rook is one L-jump away.

hints.not_on_line: The queen is close, but not an L-jump away.

items.sub: Jump the knight onto every star.

items.say: Harder: the stars are far apart.
items.sub: Plan your jumps.
Tap every square this knight can go to.
items.right: Perfect. You know the knight.

items.sub: Tap every square it can jump to.
items.right: You still know the knight!

classes.title: The pawn
classes.learnt: how the pawn moves and takes

items.sub: It's the smallest piece. Tap the pawn.
items.right: Yes! You start the game with eight pawns.

items.sub: On its very first move it may take two steps. Tap every square it can go to.
items.right: Yes! One step, or two on its first move.

items.sub: Where can it go now?
items.right: Yes. After its first move, a pawn goes one square at a time.

items.sub: It can't take straight ahead. Tap every square this pawn can go to.
items.right: Yes! It can take the knight or the bishop, but it can't move forward.

items.say: When a pawn reaches the far side, it becomes a queen!
items.sub: Move the pawn to the end.
items.right: A new queen! That's called promotion.

hints.not_goal: Move the pawn, not the king. Walk it to the end.

items.sub: Get one of your pawns to the far side first. Pawns take diagonally.
items.on_won: You made it to the end first!
items.on_lost: A black pawn got there first. Try again!

items.sub: Tap every square this pawn can go to.
items.right: Perfect. You know the pawn.

items.sub: Tap every square it can go to.
items.right: You still know the pawn!

classes.title: The king
classes.learnt: how the king moves and stays safe

items.sub: He has a cross on top. Tap the king.
items.right: Yes! The king is the most important piece.

items.say: The king takes one step at a time.
items.sub: In any direction. Tap every square he can go to.
items.right: All eight! One step, any direction.

items.say: The king never steps into danger.
items.sub: The black rook guards the whole second row. Tap where the king can go.
items.right: Yes! Only along the bottom row. The rook guards the rest.

items.say: The king can take too, if it's safe.
items.sub: Which knight can the king take?
items.right: Yes! Nothing protects that knight.

hints.protected: That knight is protected by the pawn on g6. If the king took it, the pawn would attack him.

items.sub: One step at a time.
The rook guards a row. Tap every square the king can go to.
items.right: Perfect. You know the king.

items.sub: Tap every safe square for him.
items.right: You still know the king!

classes.title: Check
classes.learnt: what check is and how to get out of it

items.question: is_check
items.say: When a piece attacks the king, that's called check.
items.sub: Is the white king in check?
items.right: Yes! The rook on e8 attacks the king down the line.
items.why_wrong: Follow the rook's line from e8 straight down. What does it reach?

items.question: is_check
items.sub: Is the white king in check?
items.right: Right, no check. The bishop's diagonal goes to d1, not e1.
items.why_wrong: Follow the bishop's diagonal. It goes to d1, not e1. The king is safe.

items.say: The white king is in check.
items.sub: Tap the piece that is attacking him.
items.right: Yes! The knight jumps onto the king's square.

items.sub: Move the rook so it attacks the black king.
items.right: Check! The rook attacks the king.

items.sub: Jump so the knight attacks the black king.
items.right: Check! A knight's check can't be blocked.

items.sub: Get out of check. Move the king, put something in the way, or take the attacker.
items.right: Safe! There are three ways out of check: move, block or take.

items.sub: Give check with the rook.
items.right: Perfect. You know check.

items.question: is_check
items.sub: Is the white king in check?
items.right: Yes! The bishop on h4 attacks the king.
items.why_wrong: Follow the bishop's diagonal from h4 down to e1.

classes.title: Checkmate
classes.learnt: how to win a game with checkmate

items.question: is_checkmate
items.say: Checkmate is check with no way out.
items.sub: The king can't move, block or take. Is this checkmate?
items.right: Yes! The king is in check and every way out is blocked. That's checkmate. The game is over.
items.why_wrong: The rook gives check. Can the king step anywhere? His own pawns are in the way.

items.question: is_checkmate
items.sub: Is this checkmate?
items.right: Right, not checkmate. The king can escape to h2.
items.why_wrong: Look at h2. The pawn moved, so the king has a square to run to.

items.sub: The black king is trapped behind his pawns. Find checkmate in one move.
items.right: Checkmate! The king's own pawns trap him.

items.sub: Your king helps. Find checkmate in one move. Careful: don't take away all his squares without check!
items.right: Checkmate! Your king and queen work together.

items.sub: Use your queen and king to checkmate the black king.
items.on_won: Checkmate! You trapped the king. You're ready to play real games!
items.on_draw: It's a draw. The king got away, or took your queen. Try again!
items.on_stalemate: Stalemate! The king can't move, but he isn't in check. That's a draw. Always leave him a square until you give check.

items.sub: Find checkmate in one move.
items.right: Perfect. You can checkmate!
